title: The seed library field guide
summary: A fully synthetic session: turn a small collection of planting notes into an accessible, printable guide. The structure is proven; the illustrations and print checks need another pass.

goals.title: Make the guide easy to navigate
Check the reading order on a small screen
Translate the guide after the first edition

evidence.label: Outline has one clear path from seed to harvest
Two diagrams drafted; the third is still in progress
Small caption contrast did not meet the chosen target
evidence.source: Synthetic print check, fixture C; no actual measurement

evidence.label: Translation intentionally deferred to the next edition

blockers.title: The smallest captions need a darker ink
blockers.detail: The synthetic print check failed. Adjust the caption treatment, then run the same check again before calling the print goal passed.

blockers.title: No paper sample is available yet
blockers.detail: There is no observed result for the paper test. Leave the goal unknown until a sample is checked.

suggestions.title: Resolve the smallest unproven step
suggestions.detail: Suggested prompt: Darken the small captions, repeat the print check, and attach the observed result. Keep the other goals unchanged.

suggestions.title: Consider an accessibility review
suggestions.detail: If an accessibility skill is available, use it for the reading-order goal after the diagrams settle. This is a suggestion, not an invocation.

suggestions.title: Carry the decision, not the whole conversation
suggestions.detail: Retain the edition scope, caption requirement, evidence identifiers, and unresolved paper test in the next handoff. Omit draft chatter and unrelated history.

suggestions.title: One adjustment → one observed check
suggestions.detail: Suggested loop: change captions → run the print check → record evidence → update this page. Stop after one attempt if the check cannot run; report the blocker instead of inferring success.

notes: Every name, event, decision, and result in this demo is synthetic.
Passed / total counts describe goals with supporting evidence. They are not a prediction of remaining effort.
This is a snapshot at the displayed time. An earlier result does not prove that later changes pass.
